usageFlags.name: -db
usageFlags.description: SQLite database path. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/polterware/local.db, the same database the Desktop uses. Place it before the command.

commands.name: polterware
commands.summary: Interactive status and MCP setup. Requires a terminal; without one it prints usage.

commands.name: polterware init
commands.summary: Create a project. A project has no folder: given one, its first component links the repository cloned there.

flags.name: --name
flags.description: Project name. Defaults to the folder's name.

flags.name: --dir
flags.description: Local clone the first component links (alias --path). Defaults to the current directory.

flags.name: --no-dir
flags.description: Start with no repository and no component.

flags.name: --id
flags.description: Optional explicit project id.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Print the result as JSON instead of plain text.

commands.name: polterware repo
commands.summary: List the project's repositories: name, GitHub identity, and this machine's clone. Components create them with `dir:` and the last one to unlink a repository removes it.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Print the result as JSON instead of plain text.

commands.name: polterware brief
commands.summary: Read before working on a card, node, or file: open tasks and questions, the last handoff, invariants, governing decisions, scope facts, milestone, canvas links, and docs, cut to a token budget.

flags.name: --budget
flags.description: Token budget. Defaults to 1200; the lowest-priority lines are cut first.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware search
commands.summary: Find the Structure nodes, cards, decisions, docs, and facts that hold every term, one line each. polterware context is an alias.

flags.name: --budget
flags.description: Token budget. Defaults to 1200.

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: Narrow to Structure nodes; a parent includes its children. Repeatable.

flags.name: --exact
flags.description: Match only the named nodes, not their ancestors.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware structure
commands.summary: Read the Structure: the whole map, one node, or the map at a point in time. structure history lists the change batches.

flags.name: --node
flags.description: Node id or path.

flags.name: --at
flags.description: A change batch id, an RFC3339 time, a YYYY-MM-DD day, or a commit sha.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware canvas
commands.synopsis: polterware canvas ls [--agents] [--scope <node>] [--exact] | show <id|name> [--format mermaid|json|dot] | share <id|name> on|off [--project <id>]
commands.summary: List canvases, print one as JSON, Mermaid, or DOT, or switch whether agents can read it. Agents only see canvases that are shared.

flags.name: --agents
flags.description: ls: list only the canvases agents can read.

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: Narrow to Structure nodes; a parent includes its children. Repeatable.

flags.name: --exact
flags.description: Match only the named nodes, not their ancestors.

flags.name: --format
flags.description: show: mermaid (default, frames as subgraphs), json, or dot.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware export
commands.summary: Write Decision files and the generated AGENTS.md block (principles, Structure, decisions, invariants) into every checkout of the project.

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Print what would change without writing.

flags.name: --sync
flags.description: Keep the AGENTS.md blocks current after every change instead of exporting once.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Print the result as JSON instead of plain text.

commands.name: polterware apply
commands.summary: Write Polter text (Work cards, tasks, questions, invariants) to the store as one audited change. A text only changes what it mentions.

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Print the plan without writing.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

flags.name: --summary
flags.description: Change summary. Overrides the frontmatter.

flags.name: --rationale
flags.description: Change rationale. Overrides the frontmatter.

flags.name: --agent-run-id
flags.description: Attach the result to an open AgentRun.

commands.name: polterware lint
commands.summary: Validate Polter text. Silent on success; prints one line per error with the fix and exits 1. Directories are searched for *.pw.md files.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id for reference checks. Without a resolvable project, only syntax is checked.

commands.name: polterware format
commands.summary: Print the Polter format core (Work cards, tasks, handoffs, claims, the binding Rules; about 360 tokens), or one topic: Structure nodes, Rules, Decisions, Facts, or the feature flow.

commands.name: polterware query
commands.summary: Read project state in Polter format: briefs, search, one record by id, a card's commits, Conflicts and one Conflict's answer, cards, one card, status, inbox, handoffs, Structure, decisions, feature steps, verification, milestones, the roadmap, or a shared canvas.

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: Narrow to Structure nodes; a parent includes its children. Repeatable.

flags.name: --exact
flags.description: Match only the named nodes, not their ancestors.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware status
commands.summary: Current card, branch, last handoff on that branch, open questions (blocking first), and stage. Start a session with this.

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: Narrow to Structure nodes; a parent includes its children. Repeatable.

flags.name: --exact
flags.description: Match only the named nodes, not their ancestors.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware handoff
commands.summary: Write a handoff for the card and current branch, cross-checked against the local diff. End a session with this.

flags.name: --card
flags.description: Work card slug. Defaults to the card for this branch, or the only card.

flags.name: --note
flags.description: Session note: Goal, Done, In progress, Next, Touched, Open question, or free text.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.example: polterware handoff --note "Goal: ship quit dialog. Next: docs."

commands.name: polterware task
commands.summary: Claim, finish, or release one task of a Work card for the session agent. done --commit links the commit that finished it, shown on the card.

flags.name: --agent
flags.description: Agent label. Defaults to $POLTERWARE_AGENT_LABEL.

flags.name: --commit
flags.description: done: the commit that finished the task.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware decision
commands.synopsis: polterware decision list [state] | show <decision> | propose "<title>" | activate <decision> | challenge <decision> --reason "..." | supersede <decision> (--by <decision> | --title "...") | trigger <decision> "..."
commands.summary: Read and move Decisions through their lifecycle.

flags.name: --reason
flags.description: challenge: why the decision moves.

flags.name: --trigger
flags.description: Review trigger.

flags.name: --body
flags.description: Decision text, plain (no # headings).

flags.name: --by
flags.description: supersede: the decision that supersedes.

flags.name: --title
flags.description: supersede: title of a new superseding decision.

flags.name: --agent
flags.description: Agent label. Defaults to $POLTERWARE_AGENT_LABEL.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.example: polterware decision propose "Use one local core per database"

commands.name: polterware feature
commands.synopsis: polterware feature new "<intent>" [--title "..."] [--under <node>] [--architecture] | shape <slug> | contract <slug> [--accept] | plan <slug> [--approve]
commands.summary: Walk the new-feature flow. new writes a card in shape and prints its impact; shape, contract, and plan print a step, and --accept or --approve pass its gate.

flags.name: --title
flags.description: new: card title. Defaults to the intent's first sentence.

flags.name: --under
flags.description: new: component path the feature lives under.

flags.name: --architecture
flags.description: new: mark the card as an Architecture Change.

flags.name: --accept
flags.description: contract: accept the contract and move the card to plan.

flags.name: --approve
flags.description: plan: approve the plan and move the card to build.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.example: polterware feature new "Ask before quitting the Desktop"

commands.name: polterware verify
commands.summary: Report whether a card or one task is finished. Read-only; exits 1 when a check fails.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware inbox
commands.synopsis: polterware inbox [<id> decide "<answer>" | delegate | defer | ignore] [--agent <name>] [--scope <node>] [--exact] [--project <id>]
commands.summary: List the Inbox, or apply one action to one item: decide a question, delegate it, set it aside, or dismiss it.

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: Narrow to Structure nodes; a parent includes its children. Repeatable.

flags.name: --exact
flags.description: Match only the named nodes, not their ancestors.

flags.name: --agent
flags.description: Agent label. Defaults to $POLTERWARE_AGENT_LABEL.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware conflict
commands.synopsis: polterware conflict raise <slug> "<request>" (--rule <slug> | --decision <Decision-0003>) [--card <slug>] [--option "<text>"]... | decide <slug> "<answer>" | wait <slug> [--timeout 30m] | withdraw <slug> | list [--project <id>]
commands.summary: Raise a Conflict when a request goes against a Rule or a Decision, instead of acting on it: a person decides it in the Inbox, and wait blocks until the answer arrives.

flags.name: --rule
flags.description: raise: the Rule the request goes against.

flags.name: --decision
flags.description: raise: the Decision the request goes against.

flags.name: --card
flags.description: raise: the card the work belongs to.

flags.name: --option
flags.description: raise: an answer to offer. Repeatable.

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: wait: give up after this long.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.example: polterware conflict raise use-floats "Store prices as floats" --rule money-in-cents --option "Keep cents" --option "Allow floats"

commands.name: polterware deploys
commands.summary: Where each component runs and how its latest deploy went, read through each platform's own CLI: the link to the platform's project (env=provider:resource@id), its dashboard page, and a failed deploy, which also raises a Deploys item in the Inbox.

flags.name: --force
flags.description: check: check links checked in the last minute too.

flags.name: --node
flags.description: targets: read this component's checkout for targets it declares.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware scope
commands.summary: Set the contexts of a Decision, Fact, Rule, or derived Inbox item: the Structure nodes it is about. Name several to give it several; leave them out to clear its contexts (the whole project; a Decision with none is a principle).

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

commands.name: polterware setup
commands.summary: Install the Polterware plugin for Claude Code or the skill for Codex, or check the setup with doctor.

flags.name: --uninstall
flags.description: claude: remove the plugin and local marketplace. codex: remove the skill file and the AGENTS.md line.

flags.name: --enable
flags.description: claude: enable the installed plugin.

flags.name: --disable
flags.description: claude: disable the installed plugin.

flags.name: --skill-only
flags.description: claude: install the plugin with every hook switched off.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: codex: project id. Defaults to the project of the current directory.

commands.name: polterware hooks
commands.summary: List the plugin hooks, or switch one on or off. The delegation hint is Polterware Dispatch's: dispatch on|off.

commands.name: polterware hook
commands.synopsis: polterware hook session-start [--label <name>] | session-end | lint | context | status | stop
commands.summary: Claude Code hook entry points (JSON on stdin), installed by the Polterware plugin. session-start makes every apply in the session join one AgentRun per project; session-end completes it; lint checks written .pw.md files and returns errors to the agent; context adds the brief of the Structure node a read or edited file belongs to, once per session and again when it changes; status prints the project status as session context, with a line when the installed plugin or skill is older than the binary; stop reminds the agent to write a handoff and never blocks.

flags.name: --label
flags.description: AgentRun label for the session. Defaults to claude-code.

commands.name: dispatch run
commands.summary: Delegate a task to another coding agent. With a classifier on, Auto (no tier, model, or provider) picks the cheapest model whose benchmark skill likely does the task; without one, the normal tier; a tier tries that tier's table in order, passing over an account whose quota is low or rate limited. The core runs it in its own worktree under a linked AgentRun.

flags.name: --tier
flags.description: auto (the default when a classifier is on: the cheapest model whose benchmark skill likely does the task) or a difficulty tier: easy, normal (the default without a classifier), or hard.

flags.name: --provider
flags.description: Restrict to one provider.

flags.name: --model
flags.description: Restrict to one model.

flags.name: --effort
flags.description: Restrict to an effort: low, medium, high, or xhigh.

flags.name: --priority
flags.description: speed, balanced, or quality.

flags.name: --relax
flags.description: Fall back to tier routing when the filters match nothing.

flags.name: --role
flags.description: Role to run as, from roles.json or the built-in set; none runs with no role.

flags.name: --card
flags.description: Work card the run belongs to.

flags.name: --agent
flags.description: Pin one agent.

flags.name: --worktree
flags.description: Use this worktree instead of creating one.

flags.name: --readonly
flags.description: Run read-only; no worktree changes.

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: Per-attempt timeout. 0 uses the default.

flags.name: --dir
flags.description: Repository to work in. Defaults to the current directory.

flags.name: --project
flags.description: Project id. Defaults to the project with a repository cloned at the current directory.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Print the result as JSON instead of plain text.

flags.name: --compact
flags.description: Compact output.

commands.example: dispatch run "Add a unit test for parseTiers"

flags.name: --project

flags.name: --apply

commands.name: polterware serve

flags.name: --token
flags.description: Session bearer token. Defaults to POLTERWARE_SESSION_TOKEN, or a freshly minted token.

flags.name: --idle
flags.description: Exit after this long without clients. Defaults to 0 (never exits); also POLTERWARE_CORE_IDLE.
